emails.subject: campus hiring for entry-level roles
emails.body:
I noticed Xoxoday is currently hiring across several intern and entry-level positions in marketing, operations, and IT.

We are building MNGO—a campus placement infrastructure platform—and currently onboarding our first colleges. Rather than guessing what recruiters need, we are building the recruiter side around real hiring requirements.

As you scale these entry-level roles, what usually breaks first in your campus hiring workflow?

Best,
Agnesh

emails.subject: coordinating campus hiring while expanding
emails.body:
Following Xoxoday's Series C round to accelerate expansion, team growth usually brings recruitment complexity.

When hiring entry-level talent across locations, many teams deal with chaotic email threads with placement officers and unstructured resumes that make cross-college evaluation tedious.

We are building MNGO to address these operational issues and are currently onboarding our first colleges. Does this friction with fragmented college communication match your experience?

Best,
Agnesh

emails.subject: building campus recruitment workflows
emails.body:
With Xoxoday's $30 million funding raised from Giift to fuel growth, scaling entry-level recruitment becomes key.

We are building MNGO to streamline campus placement workflows and are currently onboarding our first colleges. We are offering a select group of hiring leads early access to our recruiter pilot when it opens, asking only for product feedback to ensure it solves actual hiring pain points.

Would you be open to a brief 10-minute call this week to share how you handle campus drives and help shape the pilot?

Best,
Agnesh
